covers.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished original website project cover, landscape 16:9, ideally 1536×864 or 1792×1024 if required by the generator. Full-bleed artwork, no frame, no letterboxing.
Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for the visual polish and composition of the HonkPack cover: a large project wordmark on the left, a single beautifully rendered relevant hero scene on the right, soft dimensional materials, art-directed lighting, a restrained background and generous breathing room. Create a new project identity; do not copy the goose, moving boxes, HonkPack text or branding.
This is a real software portfolio cover shown as small as 327×200 pixels. Make the project name the dominant readable graphic, and the main scene immediately understandable at thumbnail scale. Keep the wordmark and important parts of the scene within the central 80% of the image, with 10% safe margins on the outer left and right and 15% safe margins above and below. The bottom-left 20% should be quiet background for a website playback control. No small paragraphs, no fake UI, no tool logos, no credits, no watermarks, no hackathon badges, no extra words. Render the specified project name exactly once, with correct capitalization. Professional bespoke art direction, coherent light and shadows, clean silhouette, visually compelling rather than generic AI gradients.

Project: Forgotten Realms is THIS specific small 2D fantasy platformer, not the tabletop fantasy franchise of the same name.
Input image 2 is ONLY a content and pixel-art atmosphere reference from the real gameplay video: a swordsman, orange autumn forest, lavender mist, grass-topped stone platforms, a cyan fountain and a gold key. Ignore editor chrome, HUD, health bars and all screenshot text.
Create original high-quality hand-authored PIXEL ART key art, with crisp deliberately placed pixel clusters, coherent pixel scale and rich atmospheric depth. Preserve the 2D platformer identity instead of turning it into a realistic 3D RPG. On the right, the small original brown-clad swordsman stands at the edge of a mossy floating stone platform; a bright cyan magical fountain and a floating tiny gold key mark the next platform. Majestic orange-brown forest trees and lavender mist create depth behind them. Make this one lovingly composed fantasy scene with quiet space on the left for the title. Borrow the HonkPack reference's clear brand-and-hero composition and polish, but NOT its clay medium or pale background.
Text (verbatim): "Forgotten Realms" on the left in large legible ivory-gold pixel-art fantasy lettering, two balanced lines. Do not use the official Dungeons & Dragons / Forgotten Realms franchise logo, no dragons or dice or characters from that franchise, no other text, no UI overlay, no borders. Keep all crucial lettering and the fountain inside the central 80% safe zone.
